points: arXiv:2609.03781v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used in multilingual settings, yet their safety is still evaluated
This limits our understanding of how alignment failures manifest in low-resource and culturally diverse languages.
We introduce IndicSafeEval, a persuasion-based jailbreak evaluation framework for Indian languages.
